Strategy note

Insights

  1. September improved on both volume and cost, with messaging conversations up to 257 from 88 and cost per conversation down to RM32.38 from RM41.87, RM7.62 below our RM40 benchmark.
  2. The pivot from the Spiro Plus x Kosen bundle to Spiro Plus only was the turning point, with the new ads delivering 56% of conversations at about RM18 each versus about RM58 for the bundle.
  3. Budget was significantly higher at RM8,321 (RM3,685 in August) because we invested in testing, and those learnings now shape a more efficient October.
  4. Sales doubled to 16 (8 in August) on a budget that more than doubled, so ROAS eased to RM1.38 from RM1.72 as spend scaled faster than sales.
  5. Lead quality sits at 52% qualified (99 of 191 logged), 2 percentage points above the 50% we consider healthy, with a proper benchmark still to come as more data builds up.

Recommendations

  • Stabilize performance in October with a steadier, more efficient budget that keeps cost per conversation under the RM40 benchmark and lifts ROAS back toward August's RM1.72.
  • Keep Spiro Plus as the core of the spend, since the Spiro-only approach delivers the most conversations at the lowest cost.
  • Test Kosen-focused content as a standalone angle on a controlled share of the budget, building on how well the Spiro-only approach has worked.
  • Once more lead data is in, optimize the messaging template and the call to action (the line that prompts people to message) to push the qualified rate beyond 52%.
